fields.description: Role named by the owner as the accountable steward for derived metrics under this version. Engineering picks no steward; the owner links an existing role.
fields.label: Steward role

fields.description: The owner's disclosure rules for derived metrics under this version: who may see them, how they are labelled and what provenance they carry. Free policy text; engineering invents no rule.
fields.label: Disclosure rules

fields.description: Why this version was set. Mandatory on every version write.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Closed date: the day this version stopped governing new activity. Written once when a newer version supersedes it; the row itself is never rewritten.
fields.label: Superseded on
